Classic Cinnamon Roll: The roll everything began with. Soft, pillowy yeast dough rolled with fragrant Vietnamese cinnamon, finished with our signature vanilla whipped frosting, made in house. It tastes like Saturday morning before anyone else is awake.
\"Honey\" Bun Roll: Our Classic, made a little lighter and a little less sweet. The kind of bun you remember from the corner store, refined by chefs. Pure perfection, plainly.
Ultimate Roll: A cinnamon roll tower, three inches tall. Brushed with Madagascar vanilla syrup, rolled with Vietnamese cinnamon, and finished with our classic vanilla frosting and a pinch of sea salt. The roll you split down the middle and argue over.
Madagascar Vanilla Morning Bun: Yeast dough brushed with Madagascar vanilla, rolled with Vietnamese cinnamon. Simple on purpose, the way the best bakery mornings are. Best with a hot cup of coffee.
Vanilla Bean Roll: Vanilla two ways: a vanilla bean infused butter rolled through the dough, and a vanilla bean frosting on top, both made in house. Quiet, fragrant and deeply comforting.
Vanilla Donut Bun: Fluffy vanilla yeast dough with a vanilla bean swirl, finished in our vanilla donut glaze. Everything you loved about a glazed donut, baked into a bun.

Biscoff Cinnamon Roll: Yeast dough with Vietnamese cinnamon, crowned with our Biscoff frosting, made in house, Biscoff crumbs and a Biscoff cookie. Caramelized spice on spice, like the little cookie that came with your coffee.
French Toast Roll: Our French toast frosting, made in house, with fresh grated nutmeg and Vietnamese cinnamon. Sunday brunch, the way you remember it from the kitchen table.
Pecan Pie Roll: Chopped pecans, pure vanilla and Vietnamese cinnamon, finished with our pecan glaze. The pie that always sat on the counter at the holidays, made to hold in one hand.
Spiced Butter Pecan Roll: Chopped toasted pecans, pure vanilla and sea salt. Butter pecan the way an ice cream parlor made it, with a warm spice that lingers.
Sticky Pecan \"Praline\" Roll: Chopped toasted pecans, pure vanilla and sea salt, finished with our praline caramel glaze, made in house. A taste of New Orleans candy shops, sticky fingers included.
Red Velvet Cinnamon Roll: Red velvet yeast dough with Vietnamese cinnamon, finished with vanilla frosting and red velvet crumbs, made in house. The cake from every Southern celebration, made into a roll.
Red Velvet Roll (no cinnamon): Red velvet yeast dough, red velvet crumbs and cream cheese frosting, all made in house. Red velvet the classic way: tangy, soft and unmistakable.
Red Velvet \"donut\" Bun: Red velvet yeast dough finished in a Madagascar vanilla glaze. The red velvet donut you chased as a kid, reimagined as a bun.
Peach Cobbler Roll: Peach and Vietnamese cinnamon rolled through our dough, finished with vanilla frosting and a vanilla crumble made in house for that golden cobbler top. Warm it ten seconds and it tastes like summer leaving the oven.
Peach Pecan \"Honey\" Bun Roll: A light, fluffy bun with a pecan cinnamon swirl and a peach glaze made in house. Front-porch flavors: Georgia peaches and pecans from the yard.
Peach Pecan Hunny Bun: A cinnamon peach swirl, peach glaze and chopped pecans. Sweet, nutty and sun-warm, like peach season in a paper bag.

Blueberry Lemon Roll: Wild blueberry and organic lemon, finished with lemon frosting made in house. Bright and jammy, like the first blueberries of summer.

Raspberry Lemon Roll: Organic seedless raspberry and organic lemon under a lemon frosting. Tart, pink and clean, a roll made for a sunny window seat.
Cranberry Lemon Roll: Organic cranberry filling and a bright organic lemon glaze. A beautiful balance of tart and sweet, with the feel of a holiday table.
Strawberry Shortcake Roll: Strawberry butter, vanilla frosting and strawberry shortcake crumbles, all made in house. The ice cream truck bar you waited for all summer, made by pastry chefs.

Strawberry Dream Roll: Organic strawberry butter, creamy strawberry frosting and strawberry shortcake crumbs. Soft, pink and sweet as a childhood birthday.
Berry Dream Roll: An organic raspberry swirl under creamy strawberry frosting and strawberry shortcake crumbs. Two berries, one daydream.
Strawberry Morning Bun: Organic strawberry rhubarb with a creamy strawberry frosting. Rhubarb brings the old-fashioned tartness of a garden pie.
Raspberry Danish Roll: Our classic yeast dough with an organic raspberry swirl, vanilla frosting and vanilla cookie crumbs made in house. The bakery-case Danish, reimagined as a roll.

Apple Pie Roll: Yeast dough, Vietnamese cinnamon and an apple butter filling, finished with vanilla glaze. Grandma-style apple pie warmth in every swirl.
